questions: What is this departure trying to express?
Which convention changes; which relationships remain or reorganize?
What might an intuitive/random change of position, direction, glyph, scale or rhythm reveal? Save a baseline and try it.
What do actual baseline/candidate outputs show with real content and sizes?
Why keep, revert or revise; at what cost?
What unexpected value appeared; should the next hypothesis change?
What candidate design concept emerged and how could it be tested next?
